description: Returns the Moon's zodiac sign right now, on a UK date or at a UK date and time, tropical or Lahiri sidereal, with the degree into the sign, the next sign change and the website's one-line meaning of the sign. With a date alone it returns every sign the Moon is in that day.

date.description: UK calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900 to 2100. Without a date and a time the result is the Moon's sign right now.

time.description: UK clock time as HH:MM on a 24-hour clock. With a date it gives the exact sign at that time; without a date it is today.

zodiac.description: Tropical zodiac, which starts at the March equinox, or Lahiri sidereal. Tropical without it.

name: get_moon_sign
title: Moon sign
